description: Source code for the CodecImage class in the media GPU Android module, managing hardware buffer images, rendering, and overlay promotion hints.

classes.name: CodecImage
classes.description: Manages GPU hardware buffer images, rendering, overlay promotion hints, and resource management.

classes.name: CodecImageHolder
classes.description: Reference-counted holder for CodecImage, ensuring thread-safe destruction.

methods.name: CodecImage::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CodecImage with output buffer renderer, texture backing status, and promotion hint callback.

methods.name: CodecImage::NotifyUnused
methods.description: Releases resources and runs unused callbacks.

methods.name: CodecImage::NotifyOverlayPromotion
methods.description: Handles overlay promotion hints and updates bounds.

methods.name: CodecImage::IsUsingGpuMemory
methods.description: Checks if the image is using GPU memory.

methods.name: CodecImage::UpdateAndBindTexImage
methods.description: Binds the texture image to a service ID.

methods.name: CodecImage::RenderToTextureOwnerBackBuffer
methods.description: Renders image to texture owner back buffer.

methods.name: CodecImage::RenderToTextureOwnerFrontBuffer
methods.description: Renders image to texture owner front buffer.

methods.name: CodecImage::TextureOwnerBindsTextureOnUpdate
methods.description: Checks if texture owner binds texture on update.

methods.name: CodecImage::GetAHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware buffer associated with the image.
